translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Default exit follows the catalogue's own guidance for mean reversion: exit at the next open after Close > SMA(5) (short: Close < SMA(5)), with a protective ATR stop and a time limit.

strategies.name: RSI Bullish Regular Divergence
strategies.entry: low < low[$n] and rsi(close, 14) > rsi(close, 14)[$n] and rsi(close, 14) < 35
assumptions: divergence lookback n unspecified; 5/10/20 tested on the discovery segment

strategies.name: RSI Bearish Regular Divergence
strategies.entry: high > high[$n] and rsi(close, 14) < rsi(close, 14)[$n] and rsi(close, 14) > 65

strategies.name: RSI Hidden Bearish Divergence
strategies.entry: close < sma(close, 50) and high < high[$n] and rsi(close, 14) > rsi(close, 14)[$n]

strategies.name: RSI Failure Swing Bottom
strategies.entry: any_of(rsi(close, 14) < 30, 20) and lowest(rsi(close, 14), 5) > lowest(rsi(close, 14), 20) and cross_above(rsi(close, 14), highest(rsi(close, 14), 10)[1])
assumptions: RSI_Low1 < 30 within 20 bars; second low (last 5 bars) higher than the 20-bar RSI low; trigger when RSI exceeds its prior 10-bar peak

strategies.name: Stochastic Pop (Trend Pullback)
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 50) and any_of(stoch_k(14, 3) < 30, 3) and cross_above(stoch_k(14, 3), stoch_d(14, 3, 3))
assumptions: 'dips below 30 then crosses' = %K below 30 within the last 3 bars

strategies.name: CCI Zero-Line Rejection Bounce
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 100) and between(cci(20)[1], -20, 20) and cci(20) > cci(20)[1]
assumptions: 'dips to [-20,20] and turns upward' = previous CCI in the band and rising now

strategies.name: Double Bollinger Band Mean Reversion
assumptions: 2-SD lower band touched within the last 3 bars, then close reclaims the 1-SD band

strategies.name: Keltner Channel Extreme Stretch Fade
strategies.entry: low < kc_lower(20, 2.5) and rsi(close, 14) < 30 and close > open

strategies.name: 50-DMA Swing Pullback Bounce
strategies.entry: sma(close, 50) > sma(close, 200) and abs(low - sma(close, 50)) <= 0.005 * sma(close, 50) and close > open

strategies.name: Awesome Oscillator Twin Peaks Bottom
strategies.entry: ao < 0 and ao > ao[1] and ao[1] < ao[2] and ao[1] > lowest(ao, 30)[3] and lowest(ao, 30)[3] < 0
assumptions: trough 2 = the AO low one bar ago; trough 1 = the lowest AO of the 30 bars before it; second trough higher; green bar now

strategies.name: Awesome Oscillator Saucer Pullback
strategies.entry: ao > 0 and ao[1] < ao[2] and ao[2] < ao[3] and ao > ao[1]

strategies.name: Fisher Transform Extreme Reversal
assumptions: Fisher_Trigger = Fisher value one bar earlier

strategies.name: Inverse Fisher Transform on RSI
assumptions: IFT(RSI) rescaled to 0..100 so the 20 threshold applies

strategies.name: Linear Regression Channel Lower Band Bounce
strategies.entry: low <= linreg(close, 50) - 2 * stderr(close, 50) and close > open

strategies.name: Laguerre RSI Fractal Reset
strategies.entry: close > sma(close, 100) and laguerre_rsi(0.5)[1] == 0 and laguerre_rsi(0.5) > 0.15

strategies.name: Momentum Pinball (Raschke)
assumptions: daily proxy: Day-2 close above Day-1 high replaces the Day-2 first-hour-high intraday breakout (no development-window minute data)

strategies.name: Psychological Round Number Bounce
strategies.entry: abs(low - floor_to(close, $step)) <= 0.003 * floor_to(close, $step) and rsi(close, 14) < 35 and close > floor_to(close, $step)
assumptions: Major_Round_Number = nearest multiple of 100 / 500 / 1000 below the close (chosen on discovery)

strategies.name: Weekly RSI Oversold + Daily Bullish Cross
assumptions: weekly RSI is the last COMPLETED week's value (as-of join; no look-ahead)

strategies.name: Pivot Point S2 Intraday Reversion
strategies.entry: low <= (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) and close > (prev_day_high + prev_day_low + prev_day_close) / 3 - (prev_day_high - prev_day_low)

strategies.name: Pivot Point S2 Reversion (daily bars)
strategies.entry: low <= (high[1] + low[1] + close[1]) / 3 - (high[1] - low[1]) and close > (high[1] + low[1] + close[1]) / 3 - (high[1] - low[1])
assumptions: daily-bar version: the floor pivot from the previous session, pierced and reclaimed on the daily close

strategies.name: Camarilla L3 Range Reversion
strategies.entry: low < prev_day_close - 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 4 and close > prev_day_close - 1.1 * (prev_day_high - prev_day_low) / 4

strategies.name: Pretty Good Oscillator Mean Reversion
strategies.entry: lowest((close - sma(close, 14)) / atr(14), 5)[1] < -3.0 and cross_above((close - sma(close, 14)) / atr(14), -2.5)
assumptions: 'from below -3.0' = PGO below -3 within the previous 5 bars
